name: Squockholm Open 2025

venue.name: Arena Satelliten
venue.details: Klubben. Entrance through "Entré A", in front of the bus stops. The front door might be locked, but we will open it at regular intervals - contact the organizers if you are stuck outside.

information: Varmt välkomna till Squockhom Open 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to Squockholm Open 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.
